item.title: Samann - Raw Lover Vol 3
item.description: Label: Traxx Underground | Prix: 16,00 € | Style: House , Deep House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Traxx Underground

Prix: 16,00 €

Style: House , Deep House

Samann has always served up classically inclined house sounds on a variety of labels and Traxx Underground is home to his latest. Opener 'Your Touch' is one of his best ever to be honest - an effortlessly smooth cut with frayed edges, humid chords running through the middle and a simple but effective vocal sample full of soul. 'June' has more bounce and a hint of New York swing from the 90s while 'Your Touch' (Tuccillo dub mix) is a playful one for the early evening. The same Ibiza based producer offers a vocal mix of Them Blues that is great for sunny outdoor sessions.

item.title: James Mason - Nightgruv / I Want Your Love
item.description: Label: Rush Hour | Prix: 16,00 € | Style: Deep House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Rush Hour

Prix: 16,00 €

Style: Deep House

Rush Hour did us plenty of favours this year but by far our most cherished was the reissue of James Mason's timeless, proto-house excursions on the infamous "Nightgruv" EP. There's really not much to be said about these peerless productions, the original mix is a stunning voyage through glimmering synths backed by a chugging beat groove, but the unreleased longer edit is the one - voyaging through those gorgeous drums and piano keys like there's no tomorrow! "I Want Your Love" is another masterpiece - slo-mo hip-hop beats mixed in with those killer funk bass lines and the infamous vocals taking you to another dimension.

Tracklist:

  • A1: Nightgruv
  • A2: Nightgruv (Unreleased Longer Edit)

item.title: Galaxy 2 Galaxy - Galaxy 2 Galaxy (Reissue)
item.description: Label: Underground Resistance | Prix: 20,00 € | Style: Detroit Techno , Detroit House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Underground Resistance

Prix: 20,00 €

Style: Detroit Techno , Detroit House

The legend and influence of Underground Resistance only grows with time, even much of the Detroit collective's label wares remain hard to find, expensive and out of print. This EP from Galaxy 2 Galaxy aka a live electronic and jazz collective featuring members of the UR stable such as Esteban Adame, Santiago Salazar, DJ Dex, Gerald Mitchell, Raphael Merriweathers Jr and Mike Banks. The name was only ever used for this one EP, but few Eps have proven to be as definitive. The highlight is the Detroit techno and jazz fusion 'Hi Tech Jazz' from 1993, which set the blueprint for a style that people still try and ape today. The Model 500 co-produced electro-dreamer 'Journey Of The Dragons' is a sumptuous rush. 'Astral Apache' has a more intergalactic energy and 'Star Sailing' is a thriving ecosystem of acid, synth-heavy jazz, analogue drums and pure futuristic vision.

Tracklist:

  • A2. Hi-Tech Jazz (The Elements)

item.description: Label: Alt Dub | Prix: 24,00 € | Style: Dub Techno
item.content:encoded:

Prix: 24,00 €

Style: Dub Techno

The eighth release on Federson's own Alt Dub reattends to his pattern of split collaborations, one previous partner being cv313 (Stephen Hitchell of Echospace Detroit). Here the pairing is Estray, the Belgrade renegade with a decade of releases on Sol Selectas, Neptune Discs and Akumandra, and whose rhythm schisms draws on African and Latin structures brought to dub's lower ends. Federsen brings the analogue restraint and tape delay approach that fed him ever since his earliest spellbinding by Derrick May's 1989 tapes; 'Dubalearic' plays it straight and filtered, setting a precedent to follow on the suceeding tracks, 'Mareas Tranquilas' being the curious tech house head's exploratory choice.

item.title: The Coastal Commision Feat Cpen - Rhodes Through Space
item.description: Label: Pacific Coast House | Prix: 22,00 € | Style: House , Tech House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Pacific Coast House

Prix: 22,00 €

Style: House , Tech House

For a brief period between 1999 and 2003, Los Angeles label Pacific Coast House Recordings released a swathe of heady, sun-soaked EPs that frequently blurred the boundaries between tech-house and deep house. The man behind the imprint was Sam Robson AKA The Coastal Commission, who started the story with the original version of this sought-after EP. Now reissued on orange vinyl (a nod to the look of the original pressing), it remains a true West Coast house gem. For proof, check out the awesome 'Rhodes in Space', where drifting, ambient style chords, spacey electronics and dubbed-out synth motifs ride a chunky bassline and smooth, tech-tinged deep house drums. Flip-side 'Straight No Chaser' explores similar sonic territory, offering food for the head, heart and feet via locked-in grooves and irresistibly immersive sound design.

Tracklist:

  • A1.Rhodes Through Space
  • B1. Straight No Chaser

Chesster lands on Rutilance Recordings with a four-track EP rooted in classic deephouse.Blending old-school influences with a modern touch, the project captures the essence ofhis sound: groove-led, warm, and true to its foundations.Originally from Italy and now based in Los Angeles, Chesster has been building strongmomentum across the global house scene, with a run of standout releases and definingmoments over the past year. This EP marks an important step in that journey - not onlyas his first on the label, but also as a more personal statement. After a run of highenergy, peak-time records, the project sees him step into a deeper, more refined lane.The EP also features a special contribution from Rutilance boss DJ Steaw, adding an extra layer of character and tying it closely to the label’s identity.

item.title: Delano Smith - Feat Diamondancer - A Message For The DJ ( Jimpster Rmx)
item.description: Label: Still Music | Prix: 25,00 € | Style: Deep House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Still Music

Prix: 25,00 €

Style: Deep House

Delano Smith's "A Message For The DJ" was first released in a distant 2005 haze, but the EP has remained a classic ever since. That's because it's a prime example of the combined powers of old-school Detroit techno and more contemporary waves of European deep house; Smith is a master of this artform, and this particular release, out on Detroit's own Still Music, has the ability to please all sorts of listeners and club-dwellers. The lead tune is full-bodied groove, taking inspiration from the US' heritage, but taking the percussion that one bit closer to what many would term 'minimal'. "Inception Dub" is just as classy and laid-back, a dreamy house assemblage with seductive jazzy nuances, leaving main man Jimpster to remix "A Message For The DJ" into a more driving, more charging tech-house monster that is perhaps the pinnacle of the entire subgenre. A piece of contemporary dance music history, right here...

Tracklist:

  • A1. A Message For The DJ
  • A2. Inception Dub
  • B1. A Message For The DJ (Jimpster Red Light remix)

item.title: Rob Pearson - Slipstream (reissue)
item.description: Label: Online Collective | Prix: 20,00 € | Style: Tech House UK Repress
item.content:encoded:
Label: Online Collective

Prix: 20,00 €

Style: Tech House UK Repress

South London's Rob Pearson catches UK tech house in that brief late-90s window where the music still sounded slightly feral, before everything became so polished and deodorised. 'Slipstream' wriggles forward on clipped breakbeats and bulbous sub bass while synth lines bend and smear like heat rising off studio equipment at 4am. 'Vortex' pinches some of Detroit's chrome-plated hypnosis, though Pearson drags it somewhere murkier in temperament. There's a lovely grubby swing to 'Metaphor' too, all bleep motifs and warehouse-house pressure haze. Even the bonus beats version has a rude kind of functionality to it.

Tracklist:

  • A1. Slipstream
  • A2. Metaphor
  • B1. Vortex
  • B2. Metaphor (bonus track)
